facts.fact: NIDA's ID4Africa 2026 deck reports ID verification against the national ID in service, earning USD 66.4 million in revenue.
NIDA reports that 147+ institutions are integrated with the national ID through its integration layer, including telecoms, banks, health insurance, social security and the tax authority.
NIDA lists national ID and CRVS merging and children registration among its strategic priorities for 2026-2029, with the Jamii Number integrating birth registration.

TZA.note: RITA and ZCSRA are named only as implementing partners; no digital civil registration system is described.
Government data centres are said to host NIDA systems; no centre renting to others is stated.

facts.fact: NIDA reports 27.1 million adults registered (87% adult coverage) and shows 50.8% of the population excluded because children are deferred, which leaves under two-thirds of the whole population registered.
NIDA says children's registration through the Jamii Number, integrating birth registration, is a presidential directive and a priority for 2026-2029, with children's registration deferred so far.
NIDA's deck names NIDA as the implementer for registration, ID issuance and data management, and lists in-house technical capacity among the supports of the system.
NIDA lists the Tanzania Revenue Authority's taxpayer registration among the services integrated with the national ID, as one of 147+ institutions.
NIDA reports 22.6 million national identification numbers generated and more than 22 million ID cards produced.
NIDA reports that the tax authority's taxpayer registration, bank KYC, health insurance and pension disbursement check people against the national ID.
NIDA names SIM registration (TCRA), health insurance (NHIF), social security, banks and tax (TRA) as sectors relying on the national ID.
NIDA reports 147+ institutions integrated and USD 66.4 million revenue generated from ID verification.

TZA.note: Only an integration layer and ecosystem interoperability for the ID are described; no government interoperability framework is named.
Interoperability standards are listed as ICT support for NIDA without a named set of standards.

facts.fact: NIDA's deck lists in-house technical capacity among the foundations of the national ID system it implements.

TZA.note: Only NIDA's 156 registration centres are connected, which are not local government offices.

facts.fact: NIDA's deck says government data centres provide secure hosting of NIDA's national ID systems.

TZA.note: No digital entry of births or deaths at local offices is stated.

facts.fact: NIDA lists the Tanzania Revenue Authority's taxpayer registration among the services integrated with the national ID.
